content:
We’re back with our check-in for what’s new on Apple’s official Certified Refurbished Store this week. This week’s highlights include the MacBook Neo, new MacBook Air configurations, Apple Watch Ultra 3, and more.

Apple’s Certified Refurbished Store is a fantastic way to save up to 15% on Apple gear while still buying straight from the company’s website.

Here’s what you need to know:

  • Quality products at great prices
  • Rigorous refurbishment process prior to sale
  • Covered by Apple’s one-year limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple’s 14-day returns policy
  • AppleCare product can be purchased
  • Engraving and gift wrap not available for refurbished products

We track every addition and subtraction from Apple’s Certified Refurbished Store so you don’t have to. Inventory changes quickly, and the goal of this story is to let you know what’s in stock so you can make a purchase before it sells out.

Macs

The MacBook Neo and MacBook Air prices here remain the standout offers for me. Both are excellent ways to enter the Apple ecosystem for the first time or upgrade to something powered by Apple Silicon.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo with 256GB storage: $599 (Reg. $699 new)
  • MacBook Neo with 512GB storage and Touch ID: $679 (Reg. $799 new)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,099 (Reg. $1,299 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 1TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,529 (Reg. $1,799 new)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 2TB storage and 16GB memory: $1,949 (Reg. $2,299 new)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 256GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,269 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 512GB storage and 16GB memory: $1,439 (Reg. $1,699 new)

Studio Display

We first highlighted the availability of the Studio Display XDR via Apple’s refurb store a few weeks ago. As we always warn, inventory can vary quickly, and the Studio Display XDR is no different. We’re down to just two configurations available as of today:

  • Studio Display XDR with standard glass and tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $2,799 (Reg. $3,299 new)
  • Studio Display XDR with nano-texture glass and tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $3,059 (Reg. $3,599 new)

Apple TV 4K

The coveted base model Apple TV 4K is back in stock this week, alongside the long-running higher-end version with Ethernet connectivity. The base model tends to go quick, so don’t wait around if you want one.

  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 64GB storage, Wi-Fi: $169 (Reg. $199 new)
  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 128GB storage, Wi-Fi + Ethernet: $209 (Reg. $249 new)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear an Apple Watch Ultra 3 everyday, and there are some solid offers available on Apple’s refurb store this week if you’re looking to join the fun:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm black titanium case with Black Ocean Band: $679 (Reg. $799 new)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm natural titanium case with Anchor Blue Ocean Band: $679 (Reg. $799 new)

As always, you can keep up with all the latest Apple deals throughout the week over at 9to5Toys.
